articles.title: Pave Space raises $40 million to develop European heavy kickstage
articles.summary:
Swiss startup Pave Space has raised $40 million to develop an orbital transfer vehicle that could move satellites from LEO to their final destinations in hours instead of months.
The post Pave Space raises $40 million to develop European heavy kickstage appeared first on SpaceNews.

articles.title: NASA proposes new strategy for commercial space stations
articles.summary:
NASA, concerned about slow development of commercial markets, is considering revamping its strategy for supporting the creation of commercial space stations to succeed the International Space Station.
The post NASA proposes new strategy for commercial space stations appeared first on SpaceNews.

articles.title: Amazon wildfire emissions up to three times higher than estimated
articles.summary: Wildfires that swept across the Amazon in 2024 were the most devastating in more than two decades. New research funded by the European Space Agency (ESA) suggests emissions may have been up to three times higher than earlier estimates.

articles.title: Kona Storms Flood Oʻahu
articles.summary: Back-to-back subtropical cyclones in March fueled destructive flash flooding on several of the Hawaiian Islands.

articles.title: NASA outlines ambitious $20 billion plan for moon base
articles.summary: Along with plans for a moon base, senior NASA managers also outlined work to develop nuclear power systems for use on the moon and Mars to keep astronauts, habitats and other equipment warm while providing the electricity needed for research, construction and daily operations.
